patterns.note: Full-bleed hero imagery with a subtle dark gradient overlay at the bottom to ensure text readability, creating a dramatic and immersive introduction.
Alternating dark (black) and light (white/off-white) background sections are used to clearly segment content and provide visual rhythm down the page.
Prominent, large, sans-serif headings (Haas Grot Disp Web) are used for key messages and section titles, providing strong visual hierarchy and impact.
A high-contrast color scheme of dominant black and white is consistently accented by a vibrant, bright orange for calls to action and interactive elements.
The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height, changing its background from transparent to solid black, and becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
A dedicated 'Explore Destinations' section features an interactive-looking map with highlighted flight paths and destination markers, visually communicating service reach.
Destination offerings are presented as large, full-width image cards with text overlays and clear call-to-action buttons, creating an engaging visual gallery.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-bleed hero image with a dark, semi-transparent gradient applied to its lower portion, ensuring that overlaid text remains highly legible against varying image backgrounds.
A dynamic sticky header is implemented that reduces its height and changes its background from transparent to a solid, opaque black as the user scrolls down, maintaining navigation visibility.
Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding, often featuring large, impactful photography paired with concise text blocks, sometimes arranged in a two-column grid.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold display headings (~3-4x body) for impact, with smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels for navigation and secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; buttons and input fields have slightly rounded corners, while image cards and main content blocks maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; generous vertical spacing between major sections, with comfortable padding around content elements within sections.

standout: The site's standout design is its sophisticated blend of a dark, luxurious aesthetic with a striking, high-contrast orange accent. This, combined with full-bleed, high-quality imagery and a dynamic, transforming sticky header, creates a premium and exclusive feel that elevates it beyond typical travel sites.
